why: Adult piglins are hostile unless the player wears at least one piece of golden armor (carrying it does not count). Opening a chest within about 15 blocks of a piglin with line of sight angers it, and breaking a block of gold angers piglins within 16 blocks even without line of sight. So: wear the helmet, barter, and leave the chests and gold blocks alone while piglins are near.
trap: B: carrying gold armor is not wearing it. C and D: looting the bastion while piglins watch starts a fight.
fairness_note: Runners do mine bastion gold blocks for bartering gold (Wikipedia, raw line 50). D is wrong only because the prompt asks for no fight and the gold blocks are next to the piglins.

techniques.description: Wear one golden armor piece so piglins stay neutral.
Do not open chests or break gold blocks near piglins.

sources: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Piglin (Aggravation section; current-version page, rules unchanged since 1.16 apart from newer container types)

answer.reasoning: Gold armor keeps them neutral; containers and gold blocks anger them.

broken.why_wrong: Opening chests near piglins angers them.
Breaking gold blocks angers piglins within 16 blocks.
